title: Agent 技能、记忆与浏览器操控成为主线
opening: 今天榜单几乎被 Agent 基础设施占满：Anthropic 把 Claude 的技能体系公开成可拆解的文件夹，Vercel 则用 Rust CLI 给 Agent 一个能逐步操作的浏览器。两者都指向同一件事——让 Agent 从聊天框里走出来，真正动手。

projects.name: anthropics/skills
projects.readmeExcerpt: > **Note:** This repository contains Anthropic's implementation of skills for Claude. For information about the Agent Skills standard, see agentskills.io. Skills Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that Claude loads dynamically to improve performance on specialized tasks. Skills teach Claude how to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way, whether that's creating documents with your company's brand guidelines, analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows, or automating personal tasks. For more information, check out: - What are skills? - Using skills in Claude - How to create custom skills - Equipping agents for the real world with Agent Skills About This Repository This repository contains skills that demonstrate what's possible with Claude's skills system. These skills range from creative applications (art, music, design) to technical tasks (testing web apps, MCP server generation) to enterprise workflows (communications, branding, etc.). Each skill is self-contained in its own folder with a `SKILL.md` file containing the instructions and metadata that Claude uses. Browse through these skills to get inspiration for your own skills or to un
projects.summary: Claude 技能系统的官方示例库，每个技能是一个带 SKILL.md 的自包含文件夹，从艺术创作到企业工作流都有。
projects.problem: 它把“教 Claude 做重复任务”这件事拆成可读的指令、脚本和资源，方便你照着改自己的技能。局限在于这些是演示性质，不是开箱即用的生产模块，且绑定 Claude 的加载机制。

projects.name: meta/astryx
projects.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
projects.readmeExcerpt: Astryx An open source design system that's fully customizable and built for how we build now: by people and the agents working alongside them. **Currently in Beta** · Built on React 19+ and StyleX **Docs** · **Storybook** · **Sandbox** · **Contributing** · **Discord** Overview Astryx is an open source design system that grew inside Meta over the last eight years, where it became the most-used and largest design system in the company — powering 13,000+ apps and shaped by the engineers, designers, and product teams who depend on it every day. It ships 150+ accessible components, brand-level theming, dark mode, ready-to-ship templates, and a CLI as one cohesive system. You import pre-built CSS and use typed React components — no build plugin, no styling library to adopt — and both people and AI assistants build with the same tooling. **What makes Astryx different:** - **Open internals.** Components are built to be composed at any level, not locked behind a closed top-level API. The building blocks you'd reach for are exported directly, and when you need to go deeper, swizzle ejects a component's full source into your project to own. - **No styling lock-in.** Astryx authors its styles
projects.summary: Meta 内部用了八年的设计系统开源，150+ 组件、品牌主题和 CLI 打包成一个 React 19 + StyleX 的整体。
projects.problem: 卖点是不锁死样式：组件内部结构开放，swizzle 能把源码 eject 出来自己改。目前仍是 Beta，且 StyleX 的采用门槛需要团队自己掂量。

projects.name: google-deepmind/mujoco
projects.description: Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact. A general purpose physics simulator.
projects.readmeExcerpt: **MuJoCo** stands for **Mu**lti-**Jo**int dynamics with **Co**ntact. It is a general purpose physics engine that aims to facilitate research and development in robotics, biomechanics, graphics and animation, machine learning, and other areas which demand fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment. This repository is maintained by Google DeepMind. MuJoCo has a C API and is intended for researchers and developers. The runtime simulation module is tuned to maximize performance and operates on low-level data structures that are preallocated by the built-in XML compiler. The library includes interactive visualization in native desktop windows and web browsers. MuJoCo further exposes a large number of utility functions for computing physics-related quantities. We also provide [Python bindings] and a plug-in for the [Unity] game engine. Documentation MuJoCo's documentation can be found at [mujoco.readthedocs.io]. Upcoming features due for the next release can be found in the [changelog] in the "latest" branch. Getting Started 1. **Try MuJoCo in your browser.** Visit mujoco.org to explore MuJoCo on desktop or mobile with nothing to install, or
projects.summary: DeepMind 维护的通用物理引擎，专攻多关节动力学与接触仿真，机器人、生物力学和动画研究的老朋友。
projects.problem: C API 加 Python 绑定，运行时针对低层预分配数据结构调优，适合需要快速准确仿真的研究场景。上手曲线不低，浏览器里能先试再决定是否本地部署。

projects.name: vercel-labs/agent-browser
projects.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
projects.readmeExcerpt: agent-browser Browser automation for AI agents: open pages, read them as an accessibility tree, and act on elements from the shell. agent-browser is a native Rust CLI that gives an AI agent a browser it can drive one command at a time. `snapshot` returns the page as compact text with a ref such as `@e1` for each element. The agent acts on a ref, reads the page again to check the result, and repeats. The browser stays open between commands, so each step is one short shell call. Install - **Homebrew:** `brew install agent-browser`, then `agent-browser install`. - **Linux:** `agent-browser install --with-deps` also installs the browser's system libraries. - **No install:** `npx agent-browser open example.com`. Project installs, building from source, `upgrade`, and `doctor` are covered in Installation. Quick start The snapshot for `example.com`: - Refs describe the page at the time of the snapshot. After navigation or a DOM change, take a new snapshot before using refs again. - CSS selectors, text, XPath, and semantic locators also work, for example `agent-browser find role button click --name "Submit"`. See Selectors. - A click fails, instead of reporting success, when the target is h
projects.summary: Rust 写的浏览器自动化 CLI，把页面读成带 @e1 引用的紧凑文本，Agent 一次一条命令地操作。
projects.problem: 浏览器在命令之间保持打开，每步只是一次短 shell 调用，快照后 DOM 一变就得重新取引用。这种“看一步走一步”的节奏比一次性脚本更贴近 Agent 的实际工作方式。
